blocks.tamil_translation: the Du'as of those in the Jama'ah surround those who stay with the Jama'ah on all four sides” (because of that, protection from the harm of Shaytan is gained), Rasulullah ﷺ said, Hazrat Zaid ibn Thabit (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: طُوْبَي لِلْمُخْلِصِيْنَ، اُولئِكَ مَصَابِيْحُ الدُّجي، تَتَجَلّي عَنْهُمْ كُلُّ فِتْنَةٍ ظَلْمَاءَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Glad tidings to those of pure intention! They are the lamps of light in the darkness; because of them even great, great fitnahs are removed,” Hazrat Thawban (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ فِرَاسٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ اَسْلَمَ قَالَ: نَادَي رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ:يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ مَا اْلاِيْمَانُ؟ قَالَ: اَلْإِخْلَاصُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Firas (RH), of the tribe called Aslam, says, “A man called out to the Prophet ﷺ and asked, “O Rasulullah, what is Iman?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “Iman is pure intention.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: صَدَقَةُ السِّرِّ تُطْفِيءُ غَضَبَ الرَّبِّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو طرف من الحديث) رواه الطبراني في الكبير واسناده حسن، مجمع الزوائد:٣ /٢٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Giving charity secretly extinguishes the anger of Allah Ta'ala,” the Prophet ﷺ said, Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ ذَرٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قِيْلَ لِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ: اَرَأَيْتَ الرَّجُلَ
